newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Congress to vote on '97 budget Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Congress to vote on '97 budget Wednesday.

text.p: Venezuela's Chamber of Deputies Finance Committee on Tuesday approved a report that recommended Congress pass the government's 7.8 trillion bolivar ($16.6 billion) 1997 budget on Wednesday, legislators said.

The report came after government and opposition parties agreed to several spending modifications totalling 355 billion bolivars. The budget now now goes to the lower chamber of Congress for its second reading. Approval on Wednesday would mean the bill would pass to the Senate on Thursday for final approval.
Congress must approve the 1997 budget before the end of the week to avoid a roll-over budget based on government spending in 1996.
